# T-2: Persist review attempt history

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Extend review artifact writing so each new review attempt preserves the latest artifact names and also writes deterministic attempt-level history artifacts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Latest artifact paths remain unchanged
- Each new impl, spec, test, draft-questions, and draft-coverage review attempt creates a separate `review-history/<phase>-attempt-<NNN>.<ext>` artifact
- Existing specs without history are not migrated or inferred

## Implementation Notes
Apply to impl, spec, test, draft-questions, and draft-coverage review artifacts. Number attempts per phase so repeated impl review attempts do not consume spec/test numbering.

## Test Strategy
Flow review unit tests using a temp spec directory to assert latest and history artifacts after multiple attempts.
